SELECT /* LGVATT40010.retrievePlanDateList */ TO_CHAR(rs.plan_yyyymmdd, 'DDMMYYYY') AS CODE , (SELECT common_code_name FROM lgcom_message_label_v WHERE common_code = 'label.att.actual' AND language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}) || ' ' || TO_CHAR(rs.plan_yyyymmdd-1, 'DD/MM/YYYY') || ' (' || INITCAP(TO_CHAR(rs.plan_yyyymmdd-1, 'FMDY')) || ')'|| (SELECT common_code_name FROM lgcom_message_label_v WHERE common_code = 'label.att.plan' AND language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}) || ' ' || TO_CHAR(rs.plan_yyyymmdd, 'DD/MM/YYYY') || ' (' || INITCAP(TO_CHAR(rs.plan_yyyymmdd, 'FMDY')) || ')' AS NAME /* 요일명 3자리 약어 : DY, 요일명 : DAY, 첫영문대문자:INITCAP */ , TO_CHAR(rs.plan_yyyymmdd-1, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS result_ymd , INITCAP(TO_CHAR(rs.plan_yyyymmdd-1, 'FMDY')) AS result_dy , TO_CHAR(rs.plan_yyyymmdd, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS plan_ymd , INITCAP(TO_CHAR(rs.plan_yyyymmdd, 'FMDY')) AS plan_dy , ac_p.holiday_flag AS holiday_flag_plan , ac_r.holiday_flag AS holiday_flag_result FROM (SELECT TRUNC(SYSDATE) - (LEVEL - 1)+NVL(TO_NUMBER(lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('LGVHR_ATT_COMMON_CODE', 'APPROVAL_SEARCH_DAYS', 'A2')), 5) AS plan_yyyymmdd FROM DUAL
CONNECT BY LEVEL <= NVL(TO_NUMBER(lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('LGVHR_ATT_COMMON_CODE', 'APPROVAL_SEARCH_DAYS', 'A1')), 15)
) rs ,(SELECT TO_DATE(lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('LGVHR_ATT_COMMON_CODE', 'OPEN_YYYYMMDD', 'A1'), 'YYYYMMDD') AS open_date FROM dual) dt , tb_att_calendar_n ac_p , tb_att_calendar_n ac_r WHERE ac_p.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND ac_p.time_and_attendance_date = rs.plan_yyyymmdd
AND rs.plan_yyyymmdd >= dt.open_date
AND ac_r.subsidiary_code(+) = ac_p.subsidiary_code and ac_r.time_and_attendance_date(+) = ac_p.time_and_attendance_date-1 ORDER BY rs.plan_yyyymmdd DESC

SELECT /* LGVATT40010.retrieveApprovalEnableTimeCheck */ CASE WHEN SYSDATE < limit_date THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS approval_enable_flag /* 결재가능여부 */ , TO_CHAR(limit_date, 'HH24:MI') AS approval_end_time /* 결재마감시간 */ FROM (SELECT lgvatt_common_pkg.get_att_close_time(NVL(#{subsidiaryCode}, #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode}), 'APPROVAL', TO_DATE(#{yyyymmdd}, 'DDMMYYYY')) AS limit_date FROM DUAL)

WITH approval_end_date AS ( SELECT /* LGVATT40010.retrieveApprovalEnableFlagData */ lgvatt_common_pkg.get_att_close_time(#{subsidiaryCode}, 'APPROVAL', TO_DATE(#{yyyymmdd}, 'DDMMYYYY')) AS limit_date FROM DUAL ) SELECT
CASE WHEN dt.approval_enable_flag = 'Y' AND SYSDATE < aed.limit_date THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS approval_enable_flag
FROM TABLE(CAST(lgvatt_common_pkg.get_input_date(#{subsidiaryCode}, TO_DATE(#{yyyymmdd}, 'DDMMYYYY'), 'PLAN', TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AS lgvatt_input_date_tbl)) dt , approval_end_date aed WHERE 'PLAN' = #{planResultType} AND dt.time_and_attendance_date = TO_DATE(#{attendanceYyyymmddPlan}, 'DDMMYYYY') UNION ALL SELECT
CASE WHEN dt.approval_enable_flag = 'Y' AND SYSDATE < aed.limit_date THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS approval_enable_flag
FROM TABLE(CAST(lgvatt_common_pkg.get_input_date(#{subsidiaryCode}, TO_DATE(#{yyyymmdd}, 'DDMMYYYY'), 'RESULT', TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AS lgvatt_input_date_tbl)) dt , approval_end_date aed WHERE 'RESULT' = #{planResultType} AND dt.time_and_attendance_date = TO_DATE(#{attendanceYyyymmddResult}, 'DDMMYYYY')

WITH att_plan AS ( /* 계획근태 */ SELECT /* LGVATT40010.retrieveDailyAttendanceApprovalList */ ap.employee_no AS employee_no , em.full_name_local AS employee_name , em.org_name_local AS organization_name , em.grade_title AS grade_title
, TO_CHAR(ap.time_and_attendance_date, 'DDMMYYYY') AS attendance_yyyymmdd /* 계획근태일자 */ , ap.time_and_attendance_code AS attendance_code , ap.overtime_sum_hours AS overtime_hours , ap.evening_meal_flag AS evening_meal_flag , ap.time_attend_input_reason_desc AS input_reason ,(SELECT cc.time_and_attendance_short_name FROM tb_att_code_c cc WHERE cc.subsidiary_code = ap.subsidiary_code AND cc.time_and_attendance_code = ap.time_and_attendance_code) AS attendance_name , ap.time_attend_detail_code AS attendance_detail_code ,(SELECT lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('LGVHR_ATTENDANCE_DETAIL_CODE', ap.time_attend_detail_code, NULL, #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}) FROM dual) AS attendance_detail_name
, larn.request_master_id , larn.request_code /* 승인라인 결재상태가 Wait for Approval(2) 이고, 결재 가능한 계획 근태일이면서 결재가능시간 이전인 경우만 결재가능 Y, 그외는 결재불가능 N */
, CASE WHEN dt.approval_enable_flag = 'Y' AND SYSDATE < lgvatt_common_pkg.get_att_close_time(ap.subsidiary_code, 'APPROVAL', ap.time_and_attendance_date, ap.shift_type_code) THEN CASE WHEN MAX(lasn.approval_status_code) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY lasn.approval_seqs) = '2' /* 1차결재 가능한 상태 */ OR MAX(lasn.approval_status_code) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY lasn.approval_seqs) = '2' /* 최종결재 가능한 상태 */ THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ELSE 'N' END AS wait_approval_flag
, COUNT(lasn.user_no) AS approver_cnt , MAX(lasn.approval_comment) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY lasn.approval_seqs) AS approval_comment1 , MAX(lasn.approval_comment) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY lasn.approval_seqs) AS approval_comment2
FROM tb_att_plan_n ap /* 계획근태 */ , emp_master em /* 임직원마스터 */ , lgcom_approval_request_n larn /* 공통결재마스터(계획) */ , lgcom_approval_status_n lasn /* 공통결재자별 결재상태(계획) */ , TABLE(CAST(lgvatt_common_pkg.get_input_date(#{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode}, TO_DATE(#{planYyyymmdd}, 'DDMMYYYY'), 'PLAN', TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AS lgvatt_input_date_tbl)) dt /* 결재가능일자 확인하기 위한 join */
WHERE ap.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND ap.time_and_attendance_date = TO_DATE(#{planYyyymmdd}, 'DDMMYYYY') AND em.employee_number = ap.employee_no
AND (em.date_retire IS NULL OR em.date_retire >= TRUNC(sysdate)) /* 재직자만 */
AND em.assignment_category = 'LGD_OW' /* 사무직만 조회 */ AND larn.request_master_id = ap.approval_request_id AND larn.request_code = ap.request_code AND lasn.request_master_id = larn.request_master_id AND lasn.request_code = larn.request_code AND lasn.approval_action_code = 'APPROVAL' /* 결재자만 조회 */ AND lasn.user_no = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.employeeNo}
AND dt.time_and_attendance_date = ap.time_and_attendance_date /* 결재자가 동일한 경우 처리하기 위한 group by */ GROUP BY ap.employee_no , em.full_name_local , em.org_name_local , em.grade_title
, TO_CHAR(ap.time_and_attendance_date, 'DDMMYYYY') , ap.subsidiary_code , ap.time_and_attendance_code , ap.overtime_sum_hours , ap.evening_meal_flag , ap.time_attend_input_reason_desc , ap.time_attend_detail_code
, larn.request_master_id , larn.request_code , dt.approval_enable_flag , lgvatt_common_pkg.get_att_close_time(ap.subsidiary_code, 'APPROVAL', ap.time_and_attendance_date, ap.shift_type_code) ) , att_result AS ( /* 실적근태 */ SELECT /* LGVATT40010.retrieveDailyAttendanceApprovalList */ ar.employee_no AS employee_no , em.full_name_local AS employee_name , em.org_name_local AS organization_name , em.grade_title AS grade_title
, TO_CHAR(ar.time_and_attendance_date, 'DDMMYYYY') AS attendance_yyyymmdd /* 실적근태일자 */ ,(SELECT TO_CHAR(lgvatt_common_pkg.get_idcard_inout_time (ar.subsidiary_code, ar.employee_no, ar.time_and_attendance_date, 'IN'), 'HH24:MI') FROM dual) AS in_time /* 출근시간 */ ,(SELECT TO_CHAR(lgvatt_common_pkg.get_idcard_inout_time (ar.subsidiary_code, ar.employee_no, ar.time_and_attendance_date, 'OUT'), 'HH24:MI') FROM dual) AS out_time /* 퇴근시간 */ , ar.time_and_attendance_code AS attendance_code , ar.work_hours -NVL(ar.tardy_hours, 0) -NVL(ar.early_leave_hours, 0) -NVL(ar.going_out_hours, 0) AS work_hours , NVL(ar.weekday_overtime_hours, 0) +NVL(ar.holiday_overtime_hours, 0) +NVL(ar.public_holiday_overtime_hours, 0) AS overtime_hours -- Over Time
, NVL(ar.weekday_night_overtime_hours, 0) +NVL(ar.weekday_ot_af_night_work_hours, 0) +NVL(ar.holiday_night_overtime_hours, 0) +NVL(ar.public_holiday_night_ot_hours, 0) AS night_overtime_hours -- Over Time at Night
, NVL(ar.normal_night_overtime_hours, 0) AS night_hours -- Night Time , ar.time_attend_input_reason_desc AS input_reason ,(SELECT cc.time_and_attendance_short_name FROM tb_att_code_c cc WHERE cc.subsidiary_code = ar.subsidiary_code AND cc.time_and_attendance_code = ar.time_and_attendance_code) AS attendance_name , ar.time_attend_detail_code AS attendance_detail_code ,(SELECT lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('LGVHR_ATTENDANCE_DETAIL_CODE', ar.time_attend_detail_code, NULL, #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}) FROM dual) AS attendance_detail_name
, ar.evening_meal_flag AS evening_meal_flag , TO_CHAR(ar.tardy_hours, 'FM990.0') AS tardy_hours , TO_CHAR(ar.early_leave_hours, 'FM990.0') AS early_leave_hours , TO_CHAR(ar.going_out_hours, 'FM990.0') AS going_out_hours , TO_CHAR(NVL(ar.weekday_overtime_hours, 0), 'FM990.0') AS weekday_overtime_hours , TO_CHAR(NVL(ar.holiday_overtime_hours, 0), 'FM990.0') AS holiday_overtime_hours , TO_CHAR(NVL(ar.public_holiday_overtime_hours, 0), 'FM990.0') AS public_holiday_overtime_hours , TO_CHAR(NVL(ar.weekday_night_overtime_hours, 0), 'FM990.0') AS weekday_night_overtime_hours , TO_CHAR(NVL(ar.weekday_ot_af_night_work_hours, 0), 'FM990.0') AS weekday_ot_af_night_work_hours , TO_CHAR(NVL(ar.holiday_night_overtime_hours, 0), 'FM990.0') AS holiday_night_overtime_hours , TO_CHAR(NVL(ar.public_holiday_night_ot_hours, 0), 'FM990.0') AS public_holiday_night_ot_hours
, larn.request_master_id , larn.request_code /* 승인라인 결재상태가 Wait for Approval(2) 이고, 결재 가능한 실적 근태일이면서 결재가능시간 이전인 경우만 결재가능 Y, 그외는 결재불가능 N */
, CASE WHEN dt.approval_enable_flag = 'Y' AND SYSDATE < lgvatt_common_pkg.get_att_close_time(ar.subsidiary_code, 'APPROVAL', (ar.time_and_attendance_date+1), ar.shift_type_code) THEN CASE WHEN MAX(lasn.approval_status_code) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY lasn.approval_seqs) = '2' /* 1차결재 가능한 상태 */ OR MAX(lasn.approval_status_code) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY lasn.approval_seqs) = '2' /* 최종결재 가능한 상태 */ THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ELSE 'N' END AS wait_approval_flag
, COUNT(lasn.user_no) AS approver_cnt
, MAX(lasn.approval_comment) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY lasn.approval_seqs) AS approval_comment1 , MAX(lasn.approval_comment) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY lasn.approval_seqs) AS approval_comment2
/* ID Card 출입시간이 출근시간 이후이고, ID Card 퇴근시간이 퇴근시간 이전인 경우 적색 표시. 출근시간 : work_start_time, 퇴근시간 : 단부제:출근시간+9시간, 교대제:출근시간+12 */
,(SELECT CASE WHEN lgvatt_common_pkg.get_idcard_inout_time(ar.subsidiary_code, ar.employee_no, ar.time_and_attendance_date, 'IN' ) >= TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(ar.time_and_attendance_date, 'YYYYMMDD')||ar.work_start_time, 'YYYYMMDDHH24:MI') AND lgvatt_common_pkg.get_idcard_inout_time(ar.subsidiary_code, ar.employee_no, ar.time_and_attendance_date, 'OUT') < lgvatt_common_pkg.get_shift_inout_time(ar.subsidiary_code, ar.shift_type_code, ar.employee_no, ar.time_and_attendance_date, 'OUT') THEN 'Y' /*HMT_20210315*/ ELSE 'N' END FROM dual) AS in_out_time_red_flag /* 출퇴근시간 적색표시여부 */
FROM tb_att_result_n ar /* 실적근태 */ , emp_master em /* 임직원마스터 */ , lgcom_approval_request_n larn /* 공통결재마스터(실적) */ , lgcom_approval_status_n lasn /* 공통결재자별 결재상태(실적) */ , TABLE(CAST(lgvatt_common_pkg.get_input_date(#{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode}, TO_DATE(#{planYyyymmdd}, 'DDMMYYYY'), 'RESULT', TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AS lgvatt_input_date_tbl)) dt /* 결재가능일자 확인하기 위한 join */
WHERE ar.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND ar.time_and_attendance_date = (TO_DATE(#{planYyyymmdd}, 'DDMMYYYY')-1) /* 계획-1일의 실적 조회 */ AND em.employee_number = ar.employee_no
AND (em.date_retire IS NULL OR em.date_retire >= TRUNC(sysdate)) /* 재직자만 */
AND em.assignment_category = 'LGD_OW' /* 사무직만 조회 */ AND larn.request_master_id = ar.approval_request_id AND larn.request_code = ar.request_code AND lasn.request_master_id = larn.request_master_id AND lasn.request_code = larn.request_code AND lasn.approval_action_code = 'APPROVAL' /* 결재자만 조회 */ AND lasn.user_no = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.employeeNo}
AND dt.time_and_attendance_date = ar.time_and_attendance_date /* 결재자가 동일한 경우 처리하기 위한 group by */ GROUP BY ar.employee_no , em.full_name_local , em.org_name_local , em.grade_title
, ar.subsidiary_code , TO_CHAR(ar.time_and_attendance_date, 'DDMMYYYY') , lgvatt_common_pkg.get_idcard_inout_time (ar.subsidiary_code, ar.employee_no, ar.time_and_attendance_date, 'IN') , lgvatt_common_pkg.get_idcard_inout_time (ar.subsidiary_code, ar.employee_no, ar.time_and_attendance_date, 'OUT') , ar.time_and_attendance_code , ar.work_hours -NVL(ar.tardy_hours, 0) -NVL(ar.early_leave_hours, 0) -NVL(ar.going_out_hours, 0) , NVL(ar.weekday_overtime_hours, 0) +NVL(ar.holiday_overtime_hours, 0) +NVL(ar.public_holiday_overtime_hours, 0)
, NVL(ar.weekday_night_overtime_hours, 0) +NVL(ar.weekday_ot_af_night_work_hours, 0) +NVL(ar.holiday_night_overtime_hours, 0) +NVL(ar.public_holiday_night_ot_hours, 0)
, NVL(ar.normal_night_overtime_hours, 0) , ar.time_attend_input_reason_desc , ar.time_attend_detail_code
, ar.evening_meal_flag , TO_CHAR(ar.tardy_hours, 'FM990.0') , TO_CHAR(ar.early_leave_hours, 'FM990.0') , TO_CHAR(ar.going_out_hours, 'FM990.0') , TO_CHAR(NVL(ar.weekday_overtime_hours, 0), 'FM990.0') , TO_CHAR(NVL(ar.holiday_overtime_hours, 0), 'FM990.0') , TO_CHAR(NVL(ar.public_holiday_overtime_hours, 0), 'FM990.0') , TO_CHAR(NVL(ar.weekday_night_overtime_hours, 0), 'FM990.0') , TO_CHAR(NVL(ar.weekday_ot_af_night_work_hours, 0), 'FM990.0') , TO_CHAR(NVL(ar.holiday_night_overtime_hours, 0), 'FM990.0') , TO_CHAR(NVL(ar.public_holiday_night_ot_hours, 0), 'FM990.0')
, larn.request_master_id , larn.request_code , dt.approval_enable_flag , lgvatt_common_pkg.get_att_close_time(ar.subsidiary_code, 'APPROVAL', (ar.time_and_attendance_date+1), ar.shift_type_code) , TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(ar.time_and_attendance_date, 'YYYYMMDD')||ar.work_start_time, 'YYYYMMDDHH24:MI') , lgvatt_common_pkg.get_shift_inout_time(ar.subsidiary_code, ar.shift_type_code, ar.employee_no, ar.time_and_attendance_date, 'OUT') /*HMT_20210315*/ ) SELECT att_e.employee_no , att_e.employee_name , att_e.organization_name , att_e.grade_title ,(SELECT lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('IF_VIETNAM_GRADE_TITLE', att_e.grade_title, NULL, #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}) FROM DUAL) as grade_title_name
, att_p.attendance_yyyymmdd AS attendance_yyyymmdd_plan /* 계획근태일자 */ , att_p.attendance_code AS attendance_code_plan , att_p.overtime_hours AS overtime_hours_plan , att_p.evening_meal_flag AS evening_meal_flag_plan , att_p.input_reason AS input_reason_plan , att_p.attendance_name AS attendance_name_plan , att_p.attendance_detail_code AS attendance_detail_code_plan , att_p.attendance_detail_name AS attendance_detail_name_plan
, att_p.request_master_id AS request_master_id_plan , att_p.request_code AS request_code_plan , att_p.wait_approval_flag AS wait_flag_plan
, att_r.attendance_yyyymmdd AS attendance_yyyymmdd_result /* 실적근태일자 */ , att_r.in_time AS in_time_result /* 출근시간 */ , att_r.out_time AS out_time_result /* 퇴근시간 */ , att_r.attendance_code AS attendance_code_result , att_r.work_hours AS work_hours_result , att_r.overtime_hours AS overtime_hours_result -- Over Time , att_r.night_overtime_hours AS night_overtime_hours_result -- Over Time at Night , att_r.night_hours AS night_hours_result -- Night Time , att_r.input_reason AS input_reason_result , att_r.attendance_name AS attendance_name_result , att_r.attendance_detail_code AS attendance_detail_code_result , att_r.attendance_detail_name AS attendance_detail_name_result , att_r.evening_meal_flag AS evening_meal_flag_result , att_r.tardy_hours AS tardy_hours_result , att_r.early_leave_hours AS early_leave_hours_result , att_r.going_out_hours AS going_out_hours_result /* OVER TIME SUM */ , att_r.weekday_overtime_hours , att_r.holiday_overtime_hours , att_r.public_holiday_overtime_hours /* OVER TIME SUM */ /* NIGHT OVER TIME SUM */ , att_r.weekday_night_overtime_hours , att_r.weekday_ot_af_night_work_hours , att_r.holiday_night_overtime_hours , att_r.public_holiday_night_ot_hours /* NIGHT OVER TIME SUM */
, att_r.request_master_id AS request_master_id_result , att_r.request_code AS request_code_result , att_r.wait_approval_flag AS wait_flag_result , lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('LGVHR_ATT_APPROVAL_STATUS', lgvatt_common_pkg.get_approval_status(NVL(att_r.request_master_id, att_p.request_master_id), NVL(att_r.request_code, att_p.request_code), #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.employeeNo}), NULL, #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}) AS approval_status , att_r.in_out_time_red_flag AS in_out_time_red_flag_result /* 출퇴근시간 적색표시 여부 */
, att_p.approver_cnt AS approver_cnt_plan /* 요청서별 결재자로 등록된 건수 */ , att_p.approval_comment1 AS approval_comment1_plan /* 결재자의 1차결재의견 */ , att_p.approval_comment2 AS approval_comment2_plan /* 결재자의 2차결재의견 */
, att_r.approver_cnt AS approver_cnt_result , att_r.approval_comment1 AS approval_comment1_result , att_r.approval_comment2 AS approval_comment2_result
FROM (SELECT employee_no, employee_name, organization_name, grade_title FROM att_result UNION SELECT employee_no, employee_name, organization_name, grade_title FROM att_plan p ) att_e ,att_plan att_p ,att_result att_r WHERE att_e.employee_no = att_p.employee_no(+) /* 계획, 실적 모두 있는 경우 + 계획 없이 실적만 있는 경우 */ AND att_e.employee_no = att_r.employee_no /* 계획, 실적 모두 있는 경우 + 실적 없이 계획만 있는 경우 생략 */
AND lgvatt_common_pkg.get_approval_status(NVL(att_r.request_master_id, att_p.request_master_id), NVL(att_r.request_code, att_p.request_code), #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.employeeNo}) = #{approvaStatusCode}
ORDER BY att_e.organization_name, att_e.employee_name

WITH att_plan AS ( /* 계획근태 */ SELECT /* LGVATT40010.retrieveDailyAttendanceUnRequestorList */ ap.employee_no AS employee_no , em.full_name_local AS employee_name , em.org_name_local AS organization_name , em.grade_title AS grade_title
, TO_CHAR(ap.time_and_attendance_date, 'DDMMYYYY') AS attendance_yyyymmdd /* 계획근태일자 */ , ap.time_and_attendance_code AS attendance_code , ap.overtime_sum_hours AS overtime_hours , ap.evening_meal_flag AS evening_meal_flag , ap.time_attend_input_reason_desc AS input_reason ,(SELECT cc.time_and_attendance_short_name FROM tb_att_code_c cc WHERE cc.subsidiary_code = ap.subsidiary_code AND cc.time_and_attendance_code = ap.time_and_attendance_code) AS attendance_name , ap.time_attend_detail_code AS attendance_detail_code ,(SELECT lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('LGVHR_ATTENDANCE_DETAIL_CODE', ap.time_attend_detail_code, NULL, #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}) FROM dual) AS attendance_detail_name
, NULL AS request_master_id , NULL AS request_code /* 승인라인 결재상태가 Wait for Approval(2) 이고, 결재 가능한 계획 근태일이면서 결재가능시간 이전인 경우만 결재가능 Y, 그외는 결재불가능 N */
